rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Brings the AgentOS safety framework to Claude Desktop and other compatible clients. Provides tools to create, deploy, and manage autonomous agents with deterministic policy enforcement including PII protection, rate limiting, cost control, and human-in-the-loop approval workflows. Uses a kernel-inspired architecture where policies are enforced programmatically rather than through prompts, achieving reliable safety guarantees for agent operations.
